valid.name: multi-statement block body
valid.code: function compute(x: number): number { const doubled = x * 2; return doubled + 1; }

valid.name: conditional branch
valid.code: function maybeDouble(x: number): number { if (x > 0) { return x * 2; } return x; }

valid.name: arrow with binary expression body (non-trivial)
valid.code: const add = (a: number, b: number) => a + b;

valid.name: arrow with multi-statement block body
valid.code: const process = (val: string) => { const trimmed = val.trim(); return trimmed.toUpperCase(); };

valid.name: factory: single-statement returning object literal (creates new value)
valid.code: function build(): { name: string } { return { name: 'default' }; }

valid.name: factory: arrow returning object literal expression body
valid.code: const makeObj = () => ({ x: 1 });

valid.name: factory: arrow returning array literal expression body
valid.code: const makeArr = () => [1, 2, 3];

valid.name: constructor: returning new instance
valid.code: function create(): Map<string, number> { return new Map(); }

valid.name: extension seam: class method returning empty object (base default)
valid.code: class Base { protected serializeExtra(): Record<string, unknown> { return {}; } }

valid.name: accessor: this.X member expression (not a shim)
valid.code: class Foo { getMessage(): string { return this.message; } private message = 'hi'; }

valid.name: accessor: this.X nested member expression
valid.code: class Foo { getLen(): number { return this.items.length; } private items = []; }

valid.name: ThisExpression directly (builder pattern)
valid.code: class Builder { setName(name: string): this { this.name = name; return this; } private name = ''; }

valid.name: object property that is not a function
valid.code: const obj = { value: 42 };

valid.name: class method with multi-statement logic
valid.code: class Calc { double(x: number): number { const result = x * 2; return result; } }

valid.name: allowLiterals: true - literal return no longer flagged
valid.code: const version = () => '1.0.0';

valid.name: allowMemberExpressions: true - non-this member expression return no longer flagged
valid.code: const getX = (obj: { x: number }) => obj.x;

valid.name: sequence expression whose last operand is non-trivial (binary expression) - not flagged
valid.code: function compute(x: number): number { return (x++, x + 1); }

valid.name: padded but genuinely non-trivial: declared name reused after real logic, not the sole statement
valid.code: function process(x: number): number { const doubled = x * 2; const result = doubled + 1; console.log(result); return result; }

valid.name: padded but mismatched: declared name differs from the returned identifier - does not reduce
valid.code: function shim(x: number): number { const value = compute(x); return x; }

valid.name: padded but reassigned: declared with let and mutated before return - does not reduce
valid.code: function shim(x: number): number { let result = compute(x); result += 1; return result; }

valid.name: type-contract guard: interface-implementing trivial method has no call site to inline into
valid.code: interface ArchInterface { arch(): string; } declare function osArch(): string; class SystemProvider implements ArchInterface { arch(): string { const result = osArch(); return result; } }

valid.name: type-contract guard: protected pass-through method is a documented override seam, not a shim
valid.code: class Pipeline<T> { protected onRunStart(context: T): T { const result = context; return result; } }

valid.name: inaccessible receiver: protected field (HealthRegistry/EntityStore/RequestExecutor shape) - a subclass reaches it, an external caller cannot
valid.code: class HookInvoker { getHookErrors(): number { return 1; } } class HealthRegistry { protected readonly hooks: HookInvoker = new HookInvoker(); getHookErrors(): number { const result = this.hooks.getHookErrors(); return result; } }

valid.name: inaccessible receiver: bare this.method() where the method itself is protected (BaseError/Retry shape)
valid.code: class BaseError { protected formatUserMessage(): string { return ''; } toUserMessage(): string { const result = this.formatUserMessage(); return result; } }

valid.name: inaccessible receiver: private field, TypeScript `private` keyword rather than `#`
valid.code: class HookInvoker { getHookErrors(): number { return 1; } } class Foo { private readonly hooks: HookInvoker = new HookInvoker(); getHookErrors(): number { const result = this.hooks.getHookErrors(); return result; } }

valid.name: value-producing function (Empty.string shape): body reduces to a string literal - not a shim by DEFAULT (allowLiterals defaults true)
valid.code: class Empty { static string(): string { const result = ''; return result; } }

valid.name: value-producing function (LogEventName.create shape): body reduces to a template literal - not a shim by default
valid.code: class LogEventName { static create(component: string, operation: string): string { const result = `${component}.${operation}`; return result; } }

valid.name: value-producing function (BackoffStrategy.constant shape): body reduces to a bare identifier selecting one of two own parameters, discarding the other - the constant-backoff algorithm, not a shim
valid.code: class BackoffStrategy { static constant(_attemptNumber: number, baseDelayMs: number): number { const result = baseDelayMs; return result; } }

valid.name: receiver-binding adapter (Retry.classifierCallback shape): arrow assigned to a value forwards to a LOCALLY-SCOPED receiver's method - inlining would detach the method from its runtime-injected receiver
valid.code: interface ErrorClassifierInterface { classify(error: Error, attemptNumber: number): number; } function build(errorClassifier: ErrorClassifierInterface): (error: Error, attemptNumber: number) => number { const classifier = errorClassifier; const classifierCallback = (error: Error, attemptNumber: number): number => { const result = classifier.classify(error, attemptNumber); return result; }; return classifierCallback; }

invalid.name: trivial arrow: expression body returning non-this MemberExpression
trivial arrow: block body returning single CallExpression
trivial function declaration: returning Identifier
invalid.code: function passThrough(x: number): number { return x; }

invalid.name: trivial function expression: returning single CallExpression
invalid.code: const delegate = function(fn: () => string) { return fn(); };

invalid.name: trivial arrow: expression body returning constant literal string, allowLiterals explicitly false - the stricter opt-in posture still flags it
trivial object property arrow: non-this MemberExpression (single report, not one per node type visited)
trivial arrow: expression body returning identifier wrapped in satisfies
invalid.code: const forward = (x: number) => x satisfies number;

invalid.name: empty-statement padding before a single return - still trivial (leading `;` is not a second statement)
invalid.code: function shim(x: number): number { ; return bar(x); }

invalid.name: comma-sequence-expression wrapping a trivial call - still trivial
invalid.code: function shim(x: number): number { return (0, bar(x)); }

invalid.name: defect (a): padded single-forwarding-call is still trivial, same as unpadded
invalid.code: function shim(x: number): number { const result = bar(x); return result; }

invalid.name: defect (a)+(b): static method exact ticket shape - unpadded, exactly one message despite MethodDefinition + child FunctionExpression both being visited
invalid.code: class X { static wrap(v: number): number { return Math.abs(v); } }

invalid.name: defect (a)+(b): static method exact ticket shape - padded, still exactly one message
invalid.code: class X { static wrap(v: number): number { const result = Math.abs(v); return result; } }

invalid.name: defect (b): object arrow-valued property with block body - exactly one message despite Property + child ArrowFunctionExpression both being visited
invalid.code: const api = { get: (x: number): number => { const result = Math.abs(x); return result; } };

invalid.name: type-contract guard: trivial method with no heritage contract is still reported (private/public, no implements/extends)
invalid.code: declare function osArch(): string; class SystemProvider { arch(): string { const result = osArch(); return result; } }

invalid.name: type-contract guard: computed method name is still reported even on a class that implements a matching interface
invalid.code: interface ArchInterface { arch(): string; } declare function osArch(): string; const key = 'arch'; class SystemProvider implements ArchInterface { [key](): string { const result = osArch(); return result; } }

invalid.name: accessible receiver: a genuinely PUBLIC field forwarding to a PUBLIC method still reports - the remedy the message names is actually available
invalid.code: class Bar { getX(): number { return 1; } } class Foo { public readonly bar: Bar = new Bar(); getX(): number { const result = this.bar.getX(); return result; } }

invalid.name: genuine delegation (Predicates.satisfiesConst shape): body reduces to a CallExpression forwarding both own parameters 1:1 - still reported, the one shape this rule always flags
invalid.code: declare const DataType: { deepEqual(a: unknown, b: unknown): boolean }; class Predicates { static satisfiesConst(value: unknown, constantValue: unknown): boolean { const result = DataType.deepEqual(value, constantValue); return result; } }
